summary: Changed handle_delete_event_resource to return 200 OK instead of 204 No Content to match the Apple Calendar regression fixture, and updated 4 test assertions in caldav_event_resource.rs that expected 204.
important_context: The fixture README states fixtures encode 'the responses it must return', making the fixture the source of truth for DELETE status. Server now returns 200 to match.
Credential revocation (revoke_apple_password) and disconnect (disconnect_apple) still return 204 — those are separate operations not covered by this defect.
